sentences.text: Heard on the question of admission.
Record of the Trial Court be called for.

Also heard on I.A.No.9714/2016, an application under Section 397(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of execution of the jail sentence and grant of bail filed by the applicant namely Chandra Shekhar Modi.
The applicant has been convicted vide judgment of conviction dated 8.11.2016 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 560/2011 for an offence punishable under Section 7(1) read with Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to suffer six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.2000/- .
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was on bail during trial and he has not misused the bail.
He has deposited the fine amount.
On these grounds, the learned counsel for the applicant prays that execution of the jail sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he be enlarged on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the appeal is not likely to be disposed of in near future, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I.A.No.9714/2016 is hereby allowed and it is directed that the execution of jail sentence of applicant Chandra Shekhar Modi shall remain suspended during the pendency of this revision and he shall be enlarged on bail subject to furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of concerning Trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 19.12.2016, and on further dates as may be directed by the Registry in that regard.

(RAJEEV KUMAR DUBEY) JUDGE yog Chandrashekhar Modi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr on 15 November, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120482254/
